create_motor_model: create a MotorModel instance with torque control enabled and custom PD gains
convert_to_torque: convert motor position commands or PWM signals to actual and observed torque values
set_motor_gains: set the proportional and derivative PD gains for all motors in the model
set_strength_ratios: set the relative strength ratios for each of the 8 motors
set_voltage: set the motor voltage parameter for the DC motor model
